notes.title: Version update at the end of April
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528216/1df4a3d3071c36e2cd71790dae10cd11819b66f4.png

The content of this update is as follows:

1. Added content of 18 small levels in the fifth major level, new mechanism: rebound platform, new enemy soldier: Asuka
2. Added a dialogue before the boss battle to enhance the sense of substitution in the game
3. Added a comic book of game endings, including two different endings: light and dark
4. Added the confirmation pop-up window when deleting archives
5. Added pop-up window interface when exiting the game
6. Added the logo animation of the studio
7. Adjust the content of the first to fourth levels again, and add new mechanism: fade platform
8. Adjust the falling speed of climbing walls with special abilities to optimize the feel
9. Adjusted the scene of the first boss battle, appropriately reducing the difficulty of the boss
10. Adjust the GUI layout of the title interface
11. Fixed a bug where pressing ESC on the character attribute interface would jump to the pause interface
12. Other subtle experiential adjustments

Thank you for your continued support. The developers will continue to work hard to bring you a better gaming experience.

(Translated by Google)

notes.title: Version update at the end of March
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39528216/dc0654781ff97b7d005fe13112c6058826b8c88e.png

The content of this update is as follows:

1. The content of 18 levels of the fourth major level is over (including new enemy soldiers: silkworm, new mechanism: spiked bricks)
2. Added the final boss of the fourth stage: Dragon (the fourth stage has a complete experience)
3. New special weapon: scatter bomb (the attack coverage is very wide, causing range damage)
4. New special ability: life adsorption (automatic adsorption of life within a certain range, shield pickup)
5. Added the Boss Battle Buff system (the player can consume gold coins to temporarily maximize the level of any character attribute before the Boss battle begins)
6. New enemy soldiers: bombers (the player will explode when they get close to a certain range)
7. Adjust and optimize the existing four levels, and add the above-mentioned new game elements
8. Appropriately lower the blood volume of the snail enemy soldiers
9. Appropriately reduce the number of gold coins dropped by ordinary enemy soldiers
10. Adjust the number of times the character climbs the wall to 3 times when the character is climbing the wall (making it more valuable)
11. Appropriately adjust the feel of the character when jumping, and increase the gravity when descending 
12. Appropriately reduced the character's movement speed at high levels
13. Adjust the implementation of part of the GUI interface to make it more smooth
14. Delete the "God's Guidance (Random Selection)" button in the attribute selection interface, because receiving feedback from players feels that it will cause misunderstanding

Thank you for your continued support. The developer promises to continue to work hard to bring you a better gaming experience.

(Translated by Google)

notes.title: Version update at the end of February
notes.notes:
The content of this update is as follows:

1. Added a guide icon for the exit position after the level is unlocked.
2. Added the GUI display of the current level number. Each big level consists of 6 sections, and each section contains 3 small levels. The total number of small levels is still 18. Players can perform an automatic save every time they complete a section.
3. Added the first 4 sections of the fourth major level, a total of 12 small levels.
4. A mini-game level of the fourth major level has been added.
5. Added a bonus level of the fourth major level.
6. The fourth level contains a sentence of easter egg text for everyone who chasing dreams.
7. Fixed a display error that may be encountered by integrated graphics devices.
8. Adjusted the art resources of the key picked up to make it more conspicuous.
9. Adjusted the control feel of the character.

Since the Lunar New Year holiday has passed, it will be adjusted to the monthly update mode in the future. The next version update will be at the end of March, so stay tuned!

(Translated by Google)

notes.title: February 7, 2021 The first _half month_ version minor update
notes.notes:
1. Reminder text will appear when picking up dropped objects.
2. Adjust the collision frame of the prop "Catapult" from rectangle to circle.
3. The content of the three existing three levels has been increased, and the original level has been adjusted from 16 small levels to 18 small levels.
4. A new level element "rolling platform" has been added.
5. Added the function of "spinning" to many related card elements, resulting in many new organ traps.
6. Added a new special ability: magnetic adsorption.
7. Now you can directly view the player's current attributes in the upgrade interface.
8. Added reminder icons for special abilities.
9. The first time you enter the puzzle game level, the gameplay teaching interface will automatically pop up.
10. Added eyebrows to the image of Boss3 and adjusted the visual effect of the attack animation.
11. Added an English version to the game.
12. Adjusted the layout of some GUIs.
(From Google Translate)
